title: how to start a SUCCESSFUL small business in 2026 🌷📦 the ULTIMATE guide, advice, everything i learned
description:
hi everyone!
have you been thinking about starting your own small business in 2026? if so, here's a guide on how to start your own small business (based on my own experiences of starting a sticker shop as a teen)! i hope this can help you to get your online business started and grow your online shop! wishing you guys all the best on your shop journeys :D 🌷🤍
